`final class SnapshotImage`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotImage.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotImage.java)

The pixels of a snapshot, as opaque ARGB `int` values row after row from the top-left corner.
